description: Check one write against a rule set, as the API would, and say whether it would be allowed, denied (403) or failed (400), which statement decided it, and (with trace) what every expression evaluated to. The write is shaped like a rule test case: action, identity, token, old, new, patch, merge, now. Costs nothing and sees no data.

identities.description: Named identities the write can refer to

items.description: Items for lookups to find: { "<list>": { "<item id or alias>": { "data": ... } } }

rules.description: The rule text, or its lines as an array (as in a schema sync document)

trace.description: Include the value of every expression

identity.description: The identity making the write: { "id": "..." }, a key into identities, or null

merge.description: A merge applied to old, instead of new

new.description: The item data after the write

now.description: The time of the write, ISO 8601

old.description: The item data before the write (not for create)

patch.description: A JSON Patch applied to old, instead of new

name: eval_write_rule
title: Try a write against write rules
